scheme_name: Swami Vivekananda Single Girl Child Fellowship for Research in Social Sciences
other_conditions: Applicant must be a single girl child (the only girl in the family; no brothers or sisters) – twin daughters/fraternal daughters are also eligible

Must be enrolled in a regular full‑time Ph.D. programme in Social Sciences at a UGC‑approved university/college/institute (section 2(f) and 12(b), deemed universities, central/state funded or Institutes of National Importance)
Distance‑education Ph.D. programmes are not eligible
Age limit: up to 40 years for general category and up to 45 years for SC, ST, OBC and PWD candidates as on the last date of online application
Transgender candidates are eligible to apply
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly fellowship of ₹25,000 for the first two years, rising to ₹28,000 thereafter, along with annual contingency funding and additional assistance for PWD candidates.
